description: On the table in front of you there’s a small white lamp-like piece with a round bulb top on a base, and a separate white cup sitting off to the right. The left hand stays planted on the lamp base to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches to the right, grasps the cup as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward, then lowers it over the lamp’s round top as if to cover or fit it in place.
